# Chassis Manifest
# ============================================================
# Files synced verbatim FROM the upstream development chassis:
#   https://github.com/jpawlowski/hacs.integration_blueprint
#
# That repository is the leading one for the shared development
# environment (DevContainer, agent runtime, generic scripts and linters).
# This repository owns everything blueprint-specific.
#
# Read by .github/workflows/chassis-sync.yml, which opens a pull request
# whenever any of these files differs from upstream.
#
# This is an ALLOWLIST, deliberately. A denylist would silently pull in every
# new integration-specific file the upstream adds. Adding a file here is an
# explicit decision that it is generic.
#
# Rules for entries:
#   - One path per line, relative to the repository root
#   - No globs — every file is listed explicitly, so the diff is reviewable
#   - Blank lines and # comments are ignored
#   - A file listed here must be byte-identical in both repositories.
#     If it needs blueprint-specific content, remove it from this list and
#     own it here instead.
#
# initialize.sh removes the sync workflow and this manifest, because a
# blueprint author's own repository syncs from THIS repository (via
# .github/workflows/template-sync.yml), not from the chassis.
# ============================================================
